issue.title: Eliminate existing bob-cli clippy warnings
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-t.1 during epic verification. On current master 2037307,  exits 0 but reports three existing warnings: collapsible_if at src/native/plugins.rs:782 and :814, and question_mark at src/native/projects.rs:2298. Apply the behavior-preserving idiomatic rewrites, retain focused coverage, and require the full clippy command to complete without these diagnostics.

fields.description: Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-t.1 during epic verification. On current master 2037307, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --message-format short exits 0 but reports three existing warnings: collapsible_if at src/native/plugins.rs:782 and :814, and question_mark at src/native/projects.rs:2298. Apply the behavior-preserving idiomatic rewrites, retain focused coverage, and require the full clippy command to complete without these diagnostics.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced by the bob-cli-12 land agent on master 9258da9 (Rust/clippy 1.98.0): 'cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features' exits 0 but now reports FIVE warnings, two more than this bead's original three. Still present: collapsible_if at src/native/plugins.rs:782 and :814, question_mark at src/native/projects.rs:2298. Newly appeared since 2037307: chunks_exact_to_as_chunks at src/native/dataview.rs:2372 (suggests as_chunks::<2>().0) and at src/native/task_status_hooks.rs:1402 (suggests as_chunks::<2>().0.iter()). Impact: 'just lint' output is noisy enough that a genuinely new warning is easy to miss during epic verification -- I had to diff locations by hand to confirm none of the five came from the capture-grammar work in bob-cli-12. Please widen the fix to all five and consider gating with -D warnings so the count cannot drift again.
